evidence: app/src/api.ts:1-225 — single data module but thin: typed responses, one cache, pure helpers; pages depend on it without it depending on them

readability.rationale: A new teammate finds their way in minutes: router, API client, DOM helpers, components, then a file per page, with consistent naming and a few well-placed why-comments. No rough spots worth flagging.

findings.issue: Route regexes duplicated between server.mjs (404 decisions) and main.ts (rendering); the two can drift when a route is added or changed
findings.suggestion: Export the route patterns from one shared module imported by both the server and the client bundle

findings.issue: Unbounded parallel fetch fan-out: one request per learn-entry for the selected game (hundreds for Mew), with no AbortSignal on navigation away
findings.suggestion: Chunk the fetches (or a simple concurrency limiter) and thread an AbortSignal through get() keyed to the render token

findings.issue: Out-of-range ?page= is clamped for display but the URL keeps the stale page number
findings.suggestion: ReplaceState the clamped URL after renderResults

findings.issue: Invalid ?game= value silently selects the default game but leaves the bad param in the URL
findings.suggestion: ReplaceState without the invalid param when falling back

findings.issue: Sprite URL pattern hardcoded in code instead of taken from API data (justified by the spec's documented pattern, but an assumption baked in)
findings.suggestion: Prefer the pokemon's sprites.front_default where a Pokemon object is already fetched; keep spriteUrl only as the list-page fallback

findings.issue: Module-global cache never evicts (bounded only by URLs visited in a session); sanctioned by the spec but worth documenting
findings.suggestion: Add a brief comment noting the intended lifetime, or cap the map size

findings.issue: Re-declares the version-group map shape inline ({ name: string; order: number }) instead of Map<string, VersionGroup>
findings.suggestion: Reuse the VersionGroup type from api.ts

findings.issue: Module-global sectionId counter is hidden shared state and ids grow unboundedly across a long session
findings.suggestion: Derive the heading id from the section title or pass it explicitly

summary: A disciplined, well-typed vanilla-Vite implementation that makes the right framework-free choices: web-standard routing, a thin promise-cached API layer, safe DOM construction and careful stale-render guards. Merge blockers are absent; the only structural complaint is the duplicated client/server route table plus unbounded fetch fan-out in the moves section. I'd approve after one round of small changes.
